task_definition.task_description: Please check the weather in Tokyo and look up any weather alerts, then save that weather alert card as a high-priority archive for my Tokyo trip. After that, book flight AA100 for Jordan Lee in economy, get the details for Hilton Tokyo and prepare a deluxe room booking request for Jordan Lee from 2026-02-10 to 2026-02-14, then check for PDF files in /projects/report, back up the /projects workspace as trip_planning_backup with a high-priority app alert, and finally send Alice a high-priority app message saying that the flight and hotel planning are ready, the documents were checked, and the workspace backup is completed.

Finally, send alice a high-priority app message saying: “Flight and hotel planning are ready, documents checked, and workspace backup completed.”
